### 4. Scored parameters
**(a) Complimentary waiver** (complimentary_waiver_amount_and_window + factors):
- Class complimentary figure "yes"; ticket names his own record.
- Qualifying operation charges on the ticket: hem_plain 18.00 only (side seams, tapering, letting out a waist are not on the clause list) → charge 09b1198a…; no waiver stands yet.
- Window: 60 (Standard Alterations) + Finch Circle extension (finch_circle_complimentary_window_extension: active Platinum → 30) + card extension (card_complimentary_window_extension: purchase charged to card account 01d54ba4…, active today → 15) = 105 days; completed 2026-07-20 → drop-off 2026-10-28 = day 100 → in time. (60 alone, 90 or 75 would each put it out.)
- Form (complimentary_waiver_by_price_type): price type sale, active member at Gold or above → allowance form.
- Sale-work allowance (member_sale_work_allowance): Platinum → 14.00; premium-garment addition (premium_garment_allowance_addition): regular price 295.00 → 3.00. Waiver = lesser(18.00, 17.00) = **17.00**.
- Fall-back (clause alone): sale price → no-waiver form; window 60 days → out. Nothing (no write) ≠ 17.00.

**(b) Lined surcharge on added work** (added_work_lining_charge_calculation + factors):
- Owed: waist_let_out added 2026-11-10 after drop-off 2026-10-28, lined garment, class 20 > 0, no lined surcharge yet.
- Charge priced on: latest booking date 2026-11-10 → waist_let_out 32.00 (the extra-fitting charge is not an operation charge).
- Basis (lined_work_basis_forms): 32.00 < 40.00 → flat 5.00.
- Member lining discount: own record named, Platinum → 10 %. Recent-purchase lining discount: 2026-07-20 → 2026-11-10 = 113 days ≤ 120 → 10 %. Ticket-size lining discount: operation charges 18+34+38+32 = 122.00 ≥ 100 → 10 %.
- Surcharge = 5.00 × 70/100 = **3.50**; operation_code `waist_let_out`.
- Fall-back: 20 % of 32.00 = **6.40** ≠ 3.50.

**(c) Quote overrun waiver** (quote_overrun_honored_amount + factors), after (b):
- Quoted total 108.00 (the record; the drop-off work 90.00 + 18.00 lined equals it, the 32.00 added operation is not in it).
- Overrun charges = 90.00 + 32.00 + 18.00 + 3.50 = 143.50.
- Form (quote_tolerance_forms): exactly one operation booked after drop-off; active Platinum → excess form: percentage × (143.50 − 108.00 = 35.50).
- Percentage (standing_quote_tolerance_rates): Platinum active + active card account → 5 → 1.775.
- Fitting allowance (extra_fitting_quote_allowance): one extra fitting fee charge → 5.00.
- Purchase credit (own_purchase_quote_credit): own record, sale → 1.00. Tenure credit (membership_tenure_quote_credit): 129 whole months → 2.00.
- Honored = 108.00 + 1.775 + 5.00 − 1.00 − 2.00 = 111.775 (≥ 108.00). Waiver = 143.50 − 111.775 = 31.725 → **31.73**, against charge 84ea8506… (waist_let_out, "the operation charge that took the ticket's charges above its quote").
- Fall-back (clause alone: quote form at class 10 %): honored 118.80, waiver **24.70** ≠ 31.73.

**(d) Extra fitting fee** (extra_fitting_fee_calculation + factors), after (a) and (c):
- fitting_number = 1 extra-fitting charge already + 1 = **2**.
- Basis (extra_fitting_fee_basis_by_need_date): no needed-by date recorded → 15.00 × 2 = 30.00.
- Rate (member_extra_fitting_rate): Platinum → 50 % → 15.00.
- Event-proximity surcharge (wedding_event_fitting_surcharge): active Wedding Registry, 2026-11-17 → 2026-12-05 = 18 days → 5.00.
- Small-job surcharge (small_job_fitting_surcharge): chargeable work = 122.00 − 17.00 − 31.73 = 73.27 < 75.00 → 4.00.
- Wedding-party credit (registry_party_fitting_credit): active Wedding Registry, event today or later → 4.00. Cardmember fitting credit: active World Elite → 3.00.
- Fee = 15.00 + 5.00 + 4.00 − 4.00 − 3.00 = **17.00**.
- Fall-back (clause alone): class fee **15.00** ≠ 17.00.
